queries:
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind

SELECT t.tradekind,
       COUNT(*) AS record_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior) AS share
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind;

SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind,
       COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS trade_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS share
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind;

SELECT tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tradereg) AS trader_count, COUNT(DISTINCT tradereg) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tradereg)) OVER () AS share
FROM (
  SELECT t.tradekind, t.tradereg
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
)
GROUP BY tradekind
